trees.t: Underwater sleep while trying not to breath
Wake up & wash your face in tap air
Passive aggressive ia all we have. You Can't shout underwater
She's leaving for work in the underwater tram. I think I'll take a minute to think about it
Starting my work with the daily rebuilding of the telescope
Using air bubbles as lenses I see the outside. I suspect the world is not what it seems
Time is running out. I'm sure.
I can see her. She's at work not even noticing I'm watching
I have a proof. The world is a drop of water falling slowly to it's end
She says:"Now that you think the world is ending you seem much happier". This time I'm fighting back
She's leaving home. Not the best timing
The drop is hitting the ledge. All that's visible is the city falling apart. She's no where around
When I find her we have to swim through the city. The city is dust. We see the world outside the bubble
Outside the water drop there's more rain drops. We jump from one to the other on our way to the pond
The pond was too far, but we have the small buthtub just for the both of us
